name: Ketonemia Signal Ontology
purpose: Classify blood ketone signals by context, not by diagnosis. A language system for education, reference pages, interface outputs, AI summaries, and future licensing.
ontology_rule: KSO may classify context. It must not declare a patient state.

classes.name: Baseline Signal
classes.description: A low or non-prominent ketone signal.
classes.use: Educational explanations of normal or low ketone presence when no strong contextual interpretation is being made.
classes.boundary: Does not declare a patient state.

classes.name: Nutritional Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with low-carbohydrate nutrition or nutritional ketosis contexts.
classes.boundary: Must not imply that a reading is beneficial or safe without context.

classes.name: Fasting Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with fasting or reduced intake.
classes.boundary: Must distinguish educational physiology from individualized medical interpretation.

classes.name: Exercise / Performance Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with exercise, endurance, energy metabolism, or performance contexts.
classes.boundary: Must avoid performance claims unless sourced.

classes.name: Illness / Stress Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with illness, vomiting, infection, dehydration, stress physiology, or reduced intake during illness.
classes.boundary: Must preserve caution and route to clinical-boundary content where appropriate.

classes.name: Diabetes-Associated Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with diabetes, insulin deficiency risk, glucose status, or diabetes safety education.
classes.boundary: Must not diagnose DKA or tell users they are safe.

classes.name: Medication-Context Signal
classes.description: A signal associated with medication contexts, especially where ketone risk language may differ from glucose-only assumptions.
classes.boundary: Requires careful sourcing and boundary language.

classes.name: Laboratory Measurement Signal
classes.description: A signal explained through specimen type, assay, reporting language, or lab interpretation boundaries.
classes.boundary: Must separate blood, urine, and breath ketone measurement.

classes.name: DKA Concern Boundary
classes.description: Not a diagnosis. A boundary class used when ketone information belongs in a clinical concern frame.
classes.boundary: Must link to clinical care guidance and cited sources.

classes.name: Emergency Referral Boundary
classes.description: Not treatment advice. A boundary class for language that points toward urgent or emergency medical evaluation where source guidance supports it.
classes.boundary: Must not ask users to self-triage.
